The '''2005–06 Ekstraklasa''' (also known as '''Orange Ekstraklasa''' due to its [[Sponsor (commercial)|sponsorship]] by [[Orange Polska]]) started on 24 July 2005 and ended 13 May 2006. [[Legia Warsaw]] were crowned champions after ending [[Wisła Kraków]]'s three season winning streak. This was Legia's first title since [[2001–02 Ekstraklasa|2002]].
